options.name: description
options.description: Help text, referenced by the control.

options.name: value
options.description: The score, or null for no rating; rounded to the step.

options.name: clearable
options.description: Choosing the current value again, Delete, Backspace, or 0 clears the rating.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Focusable and announced, but not changeable.

options.name: display
options.description: Non-interactive display (role=img with the value text).

options.name: labels
options.description: Visible caption per whole step, such as 'Good'.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name (hidden input; empty when no rating).

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of the value text and messages.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Set the value, rounded and clamped (no event).

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: Show or clear an external error.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear the validation state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, and the form registration.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user changed the score: { value, validity }.

events.name: aui-hover
events.description: The pointer previews a value (null when it leaves): { value }.

cssClasses.name: aui-rating__control
cssClasses.description: The slider (or image in display mode).

cssClasses.name: aui-rating__fill
cssClasses.description: Solid symbol clipped to the filled part.

cssClasses.name: aui-rating__fill--outline
cssClasses.description: Filled copy of an icon without a solid variant (the outline is filled).

cssClasses.name: aui-rating__item--preview
cssClasses.description: Symbol while the pointer previews a value.
